issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases such as missing environment variables or database connection failures.
The instructions are heavily focused on Next.js and Hono, lacking guidance for other frameworks listed in compatibility, limiting cross-platform applicability.

scenarios.name: nextjs-email-password-auth
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers all rubric items; Response B omits key requirements.

scenarios.name: nuxt-google-oauth
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers more rubric items (server config, API route, client usage) than Response B, though both miss key elements like authClient, signIn.social, session protection, and the npx generate step.

scenarios.name: hono-drizzle-auth
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies every rubric requirement, while Response B omits key elements such as the correct imports, provider configuration, auth.handler usage, session middleware, trusted origins, client creation, and migration commands.
